title: What's New & Guide
subtitle: Discover new features, improvements, and practical guides to get the most from your dashboard.
emptyState: No content in this category yet.

pwa.title: Install the Dashboard as an App
pwa.description: This dashboard can be installed as an app on desktop, Android, and iPhone/iPad — it gets its own icon, opens without the browser's address bar, and loads faster.

help-page.title: Help Page
help-page.description: Definitions, formulas, and how to read every KPI now has its own page, complete with a customer population glossary.

reports.title: Growth, Retention & Revenue Reports
reports.description: Detailed breakdown tables for each KPI now have their own report page, separate from the summary charts, complete with a summary card on every tab.

upsell-targets.title: More Accurate Upsell Target Recommendations
upsell-targets.description: The matching method for high-margin products per customer was tightened — business segmentation is more precise and the match score is now shown as a percentage.

pareto.title: Priority Customers (Pareto) on the Analysis Page
pareto.description: Customers who contribute the most to revenue are now flagged and shown first, compared directly against the same period last year.

cross-sell-heatmap.title: Cross-Sell Map (Heatmap)
cross-sell-heatmap.description: See the buying pattern of your top 30 customers across product categories in one matrix view — green means a transaction happened, click a cell for details.

period-filter.title: More Flexible Period Filter
period-filter.description: Growth and Reports can now be viewed monthly, quarterly, semesterly, or yearly, not just monthly like before.

mobile.title: A More Comfortable Mobile Experience
mobile.description: The sidebar, tables, and charts now adapt automatically when the dashboard is opened on a phone, including when installed as an app on the home screen.

install-pwa.title: How to Install on Desktop, Android & iPhone
install-pwa.description: Full install steps for each device: Chrome/Edge on desktop, Chrome on Android, and Safari on iPhone/iPad.

pareto-customers.title: Understanding Pareto Customers
pareto-customers.description: Why some customers are flagged as priority on the Analysis page, and how to keep an eye on them.

find-upsell.title: Finding Upsell Opportunities for a Customer
find-upsell.description: How to read the high-margin product recommendations each customer hasn't bought yet.

accent-color.title: Changing the Dashboard Accent Color
accent-color.description: Customize the dashboard's main color to match your preference.

period-type.title: Using the Period Granularity Filter
period-type.description: View data by month, quarter, semester, or year depending on what your analysis needs.

exclude-intercompany.title: Excluding Intercompany Transactions
exclude-intercompany.description: Hide transactions between companies within the same group from KPI calculations.

find-definition.title: Finding What a Term Means on the Dashboard
find-definition.description: Confused by a term like "Existing Active" or "Dormant"? Here's how to find its definition.

period-choice.title: Pick a Consistent Period Basis
period-choice.body: Use Monthly to track short-term trends, Quarterly or Semesterly for routine management reviews, and Yearly to see the bigger year-over-year picture. Comparing periods on different bases can lead to misleading conclusions.

dormant-value.title: Watch Dormant Value, Not Just Dormant Rate
dormant-value.body: Dormant Rate shows how many customers you've lost, while Dormant Value shows how much business value went with them. These two cards are best read together, not on their own.

cross-sell.title: Use M1 and M2 Together
cross-sell.body: M1 (Cross Sell Ratio) shows how many customers bought more than one category, while M2 shows the average number of categories purchased. Both rising together means cross-selling is going deeper, not just wider.
